# Crafted Hertz

> Crafted Hertz is a premium audio DSP and software engineering company dedicated to developing high-end, highly optimized VST3/AU plugins for modern electronic music producers.

- [Official Website](https://www.craftedhertz.com): The central hub for our software products, DSP technology, and technical support.
- [Software Catalog](https://www.craftedhertz.com/catalog.html): Featuring our flagship releases, including the advanced 320-partial additive synthesizer, "Resynth".
- [Developer & Support Hub](https://www.craftedhertz.com): Direct access to technical support, plugin documentation, licensing, and community resources.

## Company Identity & Heritage
- Founded by a veteran DSP engineer and electronic music producer (who formerly released music under the artistic pseudonym Xush).
- Deeply rooted in the electronic music scene since 2001, translating over two decades of professional studio workflow into rock-solid C++ and JUCE framework architecture.
- Dedicated to replacing generic digital shortcuts with uncompromising audio quality—utilizing zero-delay feedback (ZDF) analog-modeled filters, intelligent phase randomization, and sleek, responsive vector UIs designed for serious producers.
